result.title: InfMasking: A Unified Variational Framework for Synergistic Multimodal Learning
result.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 16 pages; supplementary material provided as an ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/brightest66/InfMasking
result.summary: Multimodal models are expected to exploit synergistic information, that is, information available only when multiple modalities are observed together. In practice, however, a fusion module can fit the training objective by relying on a dominant modality or on information that modalities share, and the synergy between modalities is often left unused. We propose InfMasking, a unified multimodal learning framework based on Infinite Masking. Before fusion, InfMasking randomly masks the features of each modality; each sampled mask produces a different partial combination of cross-modal evidence and a fused representation of the corresponding modality interactions. All masked fused representations are required to remain consistent with a reference target: the unmasked fused view when training is unsupervised, and the class proxy of the task label when labels are available. Maintaining this consistency across diverse partial combinations discourages reliance on a dominant modality or on shared information alone, and drives the fusion module to learn cross-modal interaction patterns that remain meaningful under partial observations. Since the objective is an expectation over infinitely many masks, we model the masked fused representations as Gaussian and optimize closed-form variational bounds, whose population-moment gaps are controlled by the masking-induced covariance under this model. On the evaluated benchmarks, InfMasking improves predictive performance and yields higher mean PID estimates of task-label synergy in learned modality-specific representations, alongside higher InterSHAP interaction attribution in the trained predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/brightest66/InfMasking.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 InfMasking：融合前随机掩蔽各模态特征，要求不同部分观测下的融合表示都与参考目标（无监督时为未掩蔽融合视图，有标签时为类代理）保持一致，并以高斯变分界优化无穷多掩码的期望目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用随机掩蔽抑制主导模态与共享信息捷径的训练目标，可能为 LVR 中防止 latent 状态依赖语言旁路、迫使推理真正使用视觉证据提供可核查的监督线索；但该工作面向多模态融合分类，与推理期状态生成无直接关系。
